cli_commands.description: Performs working tree analysis, secret scan, and Level 0/1/2 test runs.
Executes risk-oriented targeted tests according to computed Test Budget.
Executes two-phase deployment protocol using immutable OCI digest.
Executes automatic application rollback or initiates DB restore gate.
Retrieves live status, active release digest, and evidence summary.
Validates documentation against actual executable capabilities manifest.

capabilities.name: Host-Side OIDC Zero-Bypass Guard
capabilities.description: Rejects any mutating SSH command lacking signed GitHub Environment OIDC token.

capabilities.name: Two-Phase DB Migration Protocol
capabilities.description: Prevents catastrophic application rollback on incompatible DB schemas.

capabilities.name: Immutable Digest Pull Engine
capabilities.description: Forces all pulls to use @sha256 digest, treating tags as aliases.
